title: Shield Generator Cogs
speaker: kenji
intro: Her shield generator feeds from this gear box! Spin its intake DOWN: pick gears so the output turns at half speed or slower — big driver won't do it, we need a SMALL driver and a BIG output!
success: The generator groans… and dies! Her shield is DOWN, Max-kun — NOW!
goalText: Starve the shield: output must turn at half speed or slower (driver teeth ÷ output teeth ≤ ½).
failText: We want SLOW: a small driver turning a big output. 8 teeth driving 24 turns it just a third of a spin!
